knimeNode.name: ECDF Plot
knimeNode.shortDescription: Displays exact final-fitness ECDF curves by series.

fullDescription.intro: Plots final fitness on the horizontal axis and the fraction of runs at or below that value on the vertical axis. The curves use exact empirical-CDF steps and consume the ECDF output of Optimization Run Analysis directly. For minimization problems, curves farther left indicate better final results.

ports.inPort: Final-fitness ECDF table from Optimization Run Analysis.
